plan.reason: The forecast predicts a drop in outdoor temperature to -4.2°C by noon on the 9th, indicating very cold conditions. Given this extreme forecast and the need to avoid overcooling which could lead to discomfort or even freezing of occupants, it is prudent to set the supply air ceiling at the minimum allowable value of 12.8°C. This ensures that the building does not risk overheating in the event of a sudden drop in outdoor temperature.
